verdict.rationale: Drata's docs say it connects systems, including on-premise tools and custom workflows, "to automate evidence collection" (drata-docs-1). It also documents Connections and Monitoring Tests (drata-docs-12, drata-docs-14, drata-docs-25), a versioned Evidence Library (drata-docs-31), and an endpoint agent that reads device security settings (drata-gh-2). A community user confirms agent-sourced compliance status appears in the dashboard (drata-comm-2). missing for 10: explicit documentation of collection schedules/cadence, timestamped artifact details, evidence that this replaces screenshot/CSV uploads, independent hands-on corroboration beyond the thin doc snippets.
